title: Writing The Man With the Funny Horn and playing it at the Missouri Theatre
summary: He wrote the song after leaving Trent and was allowed to use the slide sax only once, in St. Louis.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: How much did Louis--this is where The Man With the Funny Horn gets born; is this where you write this song?
I wrote the song a little bit after I left Trent.
It would have probably been in Cleveland. Did you do that with Claude's band too? Did you do anything with the slide sax with Claude's band?
No, I did it with Louie's band.
Now Louie's funny, because I always figured Louie was a little bit funny that way; Louie didn't like to have--
You know what happened? We played the Missouri Theatre with Louie--
St. Louis. That's the only time that they let me use 'The Man with The Funny Horn' and it broke up the place and from then on I don't remember one
